title: Rex Financial亚洲主管：总回报收益策略，可持续分派率到底能到多少？
speaker: Head of Asia at Rex Financial

segments.en: So as a manager, not only as many others, they start to think about the find a way to deliver 80 to total return income, such as the, for us, we are selling the individual stock option at around 5 to 10% out of the money,
segments.zh: 作为管理人，不只是像很多同行那样，大家开始思考如何实现总回报收益，比如我们是在个股期权上卖出价外约5%到10%的合约，

segments.en: so able to leave the upside potential. The others are using a different approach, still selling for the index option, but selling only 20, 30% of the portfolio using the different types of the portfolios, different types of the option strategy.
segments.zh: 这样能保留上行空间。其他机构用不同方法，仍然卖出指数期权，但只对组合的20%到30%操作，采用不同类型的组合和期权策略。

segments.en: I think there are the new distinctive way to get to the goal, but we probably see more and more of the ETFs are evolving to the mid investor demand to get the total return.
segments.zh: 我认为有新的独特方式来实现目标，但我们可能看到越来越多的ETF在演化，以满足中间层投资者获取总回报的需求。

segments.en: For retail investors, I do not want to get into the financial engineering and designing of the product, but is there a general trade-off between a high dividend number and how much protection you actually get? So how do we need to be approaching marketing materials all around?
segments.zh: 对散户来说，我不想深入产品的金融工程和设计，但高分红数字和实际获得的保护之间是否存在普遍取舍？我们该如何看待整体营销材料？

segments.en: Right. It's a good question, and it's also quite difficult to question as well, and your question is broadly, yes, correct. If you only focus on the higher dividend rate or the distribution on the income side, then it means that you are giving away the many of the upside potential and then probably seeing the downside of your original investment in the V.
segments.zh: 对，这是个好问题，也很难回答，你的问题大体上是对的。如果你只关注更高的分红率或收益端的分派，那就意味着你放弃了很多上行空间，可能还会看到原始配置的下行波动。

segments.en: So if you look into the index option-based strategy, probably the sustainable distribution rate could be around 10 to 12% each per annum. If you're looking for some of the single stock-based options strategy like us, then you probably see around 22-30% each will be the somewhat sustainable.
segments.zh: 如果你看指数期权策略，可持续分派率大概在每年10%到12%。如果你看像我们这样的个股期权策略，那大概22%到30%是相对可持续的。

segments.en: If you're looking for over 89-100%, it could be debatable.
segments.zh: 如果你追求超过89%到100%，那就值得商榷了。
